name: Corporate Offices
blurb: Headquarters, branch networks, R&D floors and boardrooms.
title: Corporate office interiors
intro: Headquarters, branch networks, R&D floors and boardrooms, planned around how your teams work and delivered under one contract, from the first site survey to handover.

points.title: One point of accountability
points.text: One team carries design, civil work, joinery, electrical and finishes, so there is one contract, one timeline and one person to call.

points.title: Planned around your teams
points.text: Layouts start from your teams, headcount and meeting needs, and are reviewed in 3D before anything is built.

points.title: Safe, clean sites
points.text: ISO 45001 practices keep sites safe and hygienic, including in buildings that are already occupied.

points.title: Delivered and backed
points.text: 45-day timelines and a 10-year warranty, run under ISO 9001 quality management.

deliverables: Conference room AV and video conferencing
CCTV, access control and fire alarm
clients: Essel Group — Kohinoor City and Aurangabad

faqs.question: Can you work while our office stays open?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our ISO 45001 practices cover safety and hygiene in buildings that are already in use, and we plan the order of work with you so your teams can keep working.

faqs.question: How long does an office fit-out take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the area and the scope of work. We agree the timeline with you before work starts, and work to 45-day timelines wherever the scope allows.

faqs.question: Do you sign NDAs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Several of our corporate projects are under NDA, and we show them on this site only as Confidential.

metaDescription: Corporate office interior design and turnkey fit-outs in Mumbai: reception, workstations, boardrooms and multi-site roll-outs, delivered under one contract.
